notice: SYNTHETIC external signals for the AegisShield demo. Agencies, bulletins, reports and posts are fictional. Area groupings are illustrative labels, not geographic claims. This file is not part of input_snapshot_id and never changes recovery plans.

scoring_policy.score_note: Heuristic early-warning index from synthetic team-chosen weights. Not a probability and not fitted to historical outage data.

signals.title: Feeder instability on the Kulim industrial grid (synthetic)
signals.text: Synthetic grid-operator bulletin: two unplanned trips on the feeder serving the Kulim industrial area in the last 24 hours; further interruptions are possible over the next 48 hours.

signals.title: Thunderstorm warning for Kedah and Penang (synthetic)
signals.text: Synthetic weather-service warning: thunderstorms with heavy rain expected over Kedah and Penang for the next 36 hours.

signals.title: Report of voltage dips halting tools at a Kulim wafer fab (synthetic)
signals.text: Synthetic regional news report: voltage dips this afternoon halted several tool sets at a wafer fab in the Kulim industrial area; the operator has not commented.

signals.title: Berth waiting time at Port Klang about 1.5 days (synthetic)
signals.text: Synthetic port-operator dashboard: average berth waiting time 1.5 days, within the normal range for the season.

signals.title: Unconfirmed social post about power cuts in Binh Duong (synthetic)
signals.text: Synthetic social-media post claims short power cuts in the Binh Duong industrial zone; no official confirmation.

signals.title: Grid operator confirms curtailment for Kulim industrial customers (synthetic)
signals.text: Synthetic grid-operator notice: supply to industrial customers in the Kulim area is curtailed from 24 to 27 Oct 2026 while the feeder is repaired.
